html Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) Aerospace CompositesTaufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) Aerospace Composites
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Your mission is to lead and manage the full life-cycle of our internal COPV product development projects, ensuring technical excellence and efficient execution from concept to serial production.

- Own Internal Project Management: You are responsible for the entire project management of our new COPVs from initial component design and tool concept through prototype and series production, and additionally, open to managing other projects within the company.
- Develop Technical Solutions: You evaluate new product ideas from a technical perspective, assist the team with developing robust production concepts, and calculating internal manufacturing costs.
- Coordinate Execution: You manage all project activities, resources, and timelines, ensuring all technical and operational project goals are achieved successfully.
- Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will work closely with our core internal teams: Part Design & FEM, Toolmaking, Materials & Processes, Production, and Quality Management.
- Documentation & Standards: You ensure comprehensive project documentation and adherence to internal standards and quality requirements throughout the development process.
- Internal Stakeholder Management: You act as the central point of contact, providing clear communication and aligning expectations across all internal departments involved in product development.

YOUR PROFILE

- Manufacturing and Material Expertise: You are a proactive, solution-oriented project manager with deep expertise in advanced materials and manufacturing processes.
- Educational Background: A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a similar technical field is essential.
- Technical Expertise: You are quickly able to understand difficult technical problems and can challenge your project team on their decisions. You can guide the team to making sensible technical decisions and are comfortable with making technical decisions if needed.
- Professional Experience: You bring several years of experience in product development and technical project management, ideally within the aerospace or high-tech manufacturing sectors.
- Language Skills: Proficiency in English is needed to communicate effortlessly and precisely within the team; German is also nice to have.
- Mindset & Skills: We look for someone who is quick on the uptake, possesses strong analytical skills, and demonstrates a practical, solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges. A high level of ownership for your tasks is a must.
- Communication & Drive: Strong communication and organizational skills, coupled with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, will complete your profile.
- Composites Expertise: Possessing in-depth knowledge of fiber composite materials and their associated manufacturing processes (e.g., winding, RTM, pressing, laminating) is nice to have.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

Production Control (all genders)
Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY
To end COPV failure in spaceflight. As we grow, production becomes more complex — with multiple teams, machines, technologies, and locations. Your mission is to keep all these moving parts aligned and ensure that our production output is achieved every day.

THE WHAT
You are the daily connection between planning and execution. You coordinate production teams, translate capacity and production needs into realistic plans, and react quickly when priorities, capacities, or timelines change.

You ensure:

- Production plans reflect real machine and personnel capacity
- Production targets are achieved through effective daily coordination
- Changes and disruptions are addressed with appropriate countermeasures
- Production bottlenecks are identified early and resolved together with the relevant teams
- Production, logistics, engineering, quality, and management stay aligned

You don't just plan production. You make the plan become reality.

Coordinate daily production: Align multiple manufacturing teams and ensure that production targets are achieved. → High Performance: Keep the shop floor moving.

Build realistic production plans: Translate available machine and personnel capacity into achievable plans and identify upcoming capacity increases early. → Accountability: Plan realistically. Deliver reliably.

React to changes: Identify deviations, delays, and capacity constraints and develop appropriate countermeasures together with the relevant teams. →Candor: Surface problems early and act on them.

Resolve bottlenecks: Work closely with Logistics to systematically identify and eliminate supply and material bottlenecks. → Togetherness: Production succeeds when teams work as one.

Improve production performance: Work closely with Process Engineering to identify weaknesses through recurring quality issues and increased reject rates and drive improvements. → Playfulness: Stay curious. Find better ways to work.

YOUR PROFILE

- Experience in production planning, production control, manufacturing, operations, or a comparable environment
- Strong understanding of how individual production steps influence the overall production output
- Experience coordinating multiple teams or production activities on the shop floor
- Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to align Production, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, PJM, and Management
- Structured, solution-oriented, and able to remain effective when priorities and conditions change
- Comfortable working as the central interface between planning and execution
- Strong ownership and the ability to identify problems and drive solutions independently
- German (C1 minimum) and English (B2 minimum)
- Willingness to work 95% on-site across our Garching and Taufkirchen locations

Nice to have:

- Experience in aerospace, automotive, or another complex manufacturing environment.
- Basic understanding of metal processing and/or fiber composite manufacturing.
- Experience with production planning or project management.
- Experience working in environments with multiple manufacturing technologies or facilities.

WHAT WE OFFER

- High level of autonomy & real impact: Be part of shaping our high-tech production landscape
- Flexible working hours & remote work options based on mutual agreement
- Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and space for your ideas
- Choose your own benefit: Germany ticket, Egym Wellpass, or a tax-free Give Card

jobs.occupation: Director, Solutions Engineering (SAP Hana performance) (Relationship-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

Senior Software Developer

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years with the option to extend | Starting date: 01.12.2026 | ID: APMA007/2026 | Deadline: 11.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

- Strong professional experience in C++ and Java; proficiency in Python is advantageous

- Experience developing communication protocols for hardware and device interfacing
- Strong proficiency in Linux environments and modern DevOps practices (TDD, CI/CD, build automation, Git)
- Strong English communication skills for collaborating in an international, multi-disciplinary team
- Good German communication skills are preferable

Good reasons to join:

- An international research campus enables you to think outside the box
- Basic, materials and applied research broaden your horizons
- Collaborate with exceptional colleagues and researchers
- Our own particle accelerator

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

jobs.description:
For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham
- Analyse experimental atomic clock data and participate in the interpretation of results

About you:

- Experience in one of the relevant physics fields (e.g. particle, atomic/nuclear physics, quantum optics) with Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with detector physics, with good computer programming skills
- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage
- Willingness to travel and participate in working meetings, conferences, and field work abroad (e.g. at MPIK Heidelberg)
- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the

TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Prof. Steven Worm at +49 33762-7-7208 [(steven.worm@desy.de).](https://mailto:(steven.worm@desy.de)

DESY in Zeuthen does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Potsdam or the Humboldt University. Candidates for thesis research will have to satisfy the terms of admission for doctoral theses of the University. PhD students receive a monthly salary of 67% of the payment of the remuneration group 13 TVöD (Federal Government).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV, relevant certificates and two letters of references) via our application portal. jobs.description:
KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

Join our mission to help every child reach their full potential through developmentally respectful, relationship-based care. Apply now [https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107895&tc=3-11]
